## Summary
- Mark every visible Settings dialog section title as an Android accessibility heading
- Add stable IDs for those headings so layout/instrumentation tests can assert the screen-reader structure
- Extend JVM and P0110 no-Host instrumentation coverage for the Settings heading contract

## Verification
- `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.MainActivitySettingsAccessibilityContractTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.SettingsDialogLayoutPolicyTest`
- `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ConnectionGuidanceTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ConnectionPanelLayoutPolicyTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ConnectionSubtitleDisclosurePolicyTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.MainActivityTerminalGuidanceContractTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.SettingsDialogLayoutPolicyTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.MainActivitySettingsAccessibilityContractTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ClientExperienceTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.DesignTokenContrastTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ManagedPolicyUiAvailabilityPolicyTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.QRScannerAccessibilityContractTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.StatusOverlayLayoutPolicyTest`
- `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ANDROID_SERIAL=<redacted-adb-serial> ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class=dev.telemachus.display.SettingsDialogLayoutInstrumentedTest` (P0110 / pacific / Android 16: 17 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped)
- `git diff --check`
- no-Host boundary checked before/after device run: `adb reverse --list` empty; `lsof -nP -iTCP:54321 -sTCP:LISTEN` returned no listener rows

## Boundaries
No Vibe Screen, MacHost, or Telemachus macOS GUI was launched. No `swift run`, TCC, Screen Recording, Accessibility, Microphone, Keychain, System Settings, signing configuration, or `adb reverse tcp:54321 tcp:54321` operation was used. This change improves Android no-Host UI accessibility only; it does not claim Host-backed E2E behavior.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **Accessibility**
  - Settings dialog titles, section headings, and the opacity label now expose screen-reader heading semantics, improving navigation for users of assistive technologies.
- **Tests**
  - Added coverage to verify accessibility heading behavior and preserve expected settings section labels.

title: Improve Android settings accessibility headings
